title: SBI Education Loan Schemes
summary: SBI offers a full range of education loan schemes covering studies in India and abroad, skill courses, premier institutions, defence personnel, takeovers and government interest-subsidy schemes.
body:
State Bank of India offers the following education loan schemes and related facilities:

1. SBI PM-Vidyalaxmi Scheme - For Quality Higher Educational Institutions (QHEIs) selected by Government.
2. SBI Student Loan Scheme - the general-purpose education loan for studies in India.
3. SBI Scholar Loan Scheme - For Select Premier Institutions (IITs, IIMs, NITs and other listed institutes).
4. SBI Global Ed-Vantage Scheme - For Studies abroad (above Rs. 7.50 lakhs).
5. SBI Skill Loan Scheme - For pursuing Skill development courses.
6. Takeover Of Education Loans - transfer an existing education loan from another lender to SBI.
7. Dr. Ambedkar Interest Subsidy Scheme for Overseas Studies for OBCs and EBCs.
8. Padho Pardesh Interest Subsidy Scheme for Overseas Studies for the Minority Communities.
9. Repayment - repayment terms, moratorium/course period plus grace period, and EMI servicing.
10. CSIS Scheme (Central Sector Interest Subsidy Scheme) - INTEREST SUBSIDY SCHEME.
11. Education Loan MITC - Most Important Terms and Conditions for education loans.
12. Shaurya Education Loan - For Defence, Indian Coast Guard & Central Armed Police Force Personnel.
13. Deceased Borrower/Guarantor - process applicable where the borrower or guarantor is deceased.
14. Release of Property Documents of EL - release of property documents held as security for an education loan.
